= Class: vim

Configure and manage vim
This class is meant to be included by the 'generic' module and therefore
applied to all nodes

= Parameter

$ensure:: (*Default*: 'present' ) Valid values are present or absent to
specify whether or not vim should be installed


== Requires:

n/a

== Sample Usage:

    include vim

== Warnings

/!\ Always respect the style guide available
here[http://docs.puppetlabs.com/guides/style_guide]


[Remember: No empty lines between comments and class definition]

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `vim` class:

* [`ensure`](#-vim--ensure)

##### <a name="-vim--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Any`



Default value: `$vim::params::ensure`

= Class: vim::params

In this class are defined as variables values that are used in other
vim classes.
This class should be included, where necessary, and eventually be enhanced
with support for more OS

== Warnings
